item.title: Indie Brief, Saturday 21 November
item.description:
Good morning, this is Indie Brief for Saturday 21 November.
Screen Daily reports that UK producer Rebecca O'Brien has called for radical changes to revitalise the struggling independent film sector. item.title: Indie Brief, Friday 13 November
item.description:
Good morning, this is Indie Brief for Friday 13 November.
Realscreen reports that Po Si Teng's American Doctor and Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's You Can See Everything are leading the nominations for the 20th Cinema Eye Honors, with seven nominations each including top documentary. The Cinema Eye Honors celebrate excellence in non-fiction filmmaking.

item.title: Indie Brief, Thursday 12 November
item.description:
Good morning, this is Indie Brief for Thursday 12 November.
Barbara Broccoli, the legendary James Bond producer, has been appointed as the first female president of the UK's National Film and Television School. The appointment comes just weeks before the opening of a building dedicated to her father, the iconic Cubby Broccoli. Broccoli brings a longstanding relationship with the NFTS to the role.

item.description:

The collaboration brings together the broadcaster's documentary expertise with Disney's animation capabilities.
